title: Marlowe cold room alarm runbook
brief: Marlowe Vaccine Depot needs a runbook for when the temperature alarm goes off in Cold Room B, which holds 12400 doses and must stay between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius. Owner: Depot Operations. Sections: "Alarm levels", "First 15 minutes", "Moving stock", "Quarantine and escalation" and "Contacts". Alarm levels: warning when the temperature is above 8 degrees for 10 minutes; critical when it is above 12 degrees or below 0 degrees. First 15 minutes, in order: 1 acknowledge the alarm on the monitoring panel within 5 minutes; 2 check that the door is fully shut and the seal is intact; 3 check that the compressor has power and note the temperature shown on the data logger; 4 call the refrigeration contractor Polar Service on 555-0190, who respond within 4 hours. Moving stock: if the temperature is still above 8 degrees after 15 minutes, move the doses to backup Cold Room C, which holds 9000 doses; the remaining 3400 go into the 6 validated transport boxes with ice packs; log every box on the transfer sheet. Quarantine and escalation: any lot out of range for more than 30 minutes in total is quarantined and the Quality Manager is told immediately; nobody discards anything, only the Quality Manager decides. If the alarm is not resolved within 2 hours, call the Operations Director. Contacts: Night supervisor, Gabriela Nunez, 555-0187; Quality Manager, Peter Aldous, 555-0152; Polar Service, 555-0190. Make the no-discard rule impossible to miss.

edit.request: Shorten the quarantine threshold from 30 minutes to 20 minutes, and replace Peter Aldous with Hye-jin Park as the Quality Manager.
